name: calnio-video
description: The setup video on the landing page, rendered with Remotion.

scripts.render: remotion render SetupDesktop out/setup.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=20 --pixel-format=yuv420p && remotion render SetupPhone out/setup-phone.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=20 --pixel-format=yuv420p
scripts.gallery: remotion render GalleryLoop out/gallery/1-two-way.gif --codec=gif --every-nth-frame=2 && remotion still GalleryStill out/gallery/2-hero.png --frame=95 --props='{"scene":"hero"}' && remotion still GalleryStill out/gallery/3-alerts.png --frame=120 --props='{"scene":"alerts"}' && remotion still GalleryStill out/gallery/4-setup.png --frame=295 --props='{"scene":"setup"}' && remotion still GalleryStill out/gallery/5-indie.png --frame=100 --props='{"scene":"indie"}'
